title: Why This Overlander Says Her Byrna is Her #1 Option
summary: See why this solo overlander considers her Byrna launcher essential gear for remote camping, offering peace of mind and added personal protection on the road.
body_markdown:
## Overlanding with Byrna: Why Personal Protection Belongs on the Road


For overlanding enthusiasts,[having the right gear can make a major difference](https://byrna.com/collections/byrna-non-lethal-guns) when spending extended time on the road or camping in remote areas. From recovery equipment and tools to food and shelter, a well-equipped vehicle is designed to help handle the unexpected. For some solo travelers, personal protection is an equally important part of that setup.


When camping alone in remote locations, unfamiliar sounds and surroundings can create an added sense of uncertainty. A campsite that feels peaceful during the day can feel very different at night. Having a personal protection option readily accessible can provide additional peace of mind while exploring or relaxing at camp.


For one overlander, a Byrna launcher has become one of the most important pieces of gear carried on the vehicle. While the Jeep is equipped with plenty of equipment, the Byrna stays close at hand when moving around camp. Its portability makes it easy to carry while setting up camp, exploring the surrounding area, or simply enjoying time outdoors.


The value of personal protection gear isn't necessarily measured by how often it is used. Like many other pieces of overlanding equipment, it can serve as preparation for an unexpected situation. The goal is to have the right tools available if circumstances suddenly change.


Solo camping and overlanding offer the freedom to explore places far from crowded campgrounds and busy roads. That freedom also comes with the responsibility of being prepared. Along with navigation equipment, emergency supplies, recovery gear, and communication tools, personal protection can be another consideration for responsible outdoor adventurers.


For those who spend significant time traveling and camping off the beaten path, Byrna can be another piece of gear designed to stay ready when it matters most—whether it is ever needed or simply provides greater confidence while enjoying the outdoors.
